product_description: Men's knit cotton t-shirts, short-sleeved, crew neck, 100% cotton jersey knit fabric
source: Common apparel classification; heading 6109 covers T-shirts, singlets and other vests, knitted or crocheted -- HTSUS heading text, cross-checked against CBP CROSS rulings for cotton knit t-shirts (e.g. NY N series rulings classifying 100% cotton knit crew-neck t-shirts under 6109.10).

product_description: A stainless steel vacuum-insulated double-wall drinking bottle with a screw-on lid, household use
source: Heading 9617 covers vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete, and parts thereof -- consistent with CBP CROSS rulings classifying stainless-steel vacuum-insulated bottles/tumblers under 9617.00 (e.g. NY N306XXX-series rulings on vacuum bottles).

product_description: A laptop computer, a portable automatic data processing machine weighing under 10 kg with a keyboard and display in the same housing
source: HTSUS heading 8471 covers automatic data processing machines; subheading 8471.30 specifically covers portable ADP machines weighing not more than 10 kg consisting of a CPU, keyboard, and display -- direct match to the HTSUS subheading text (laptops/notebooks).

product_description: Fresh cut roses, in bud or bloom, for bouquets
source: HTSUS heading 0603 covers cut flowers and flower buds; subheading 0603.11.00 is specifically 'Fresh, roses' -- direct HTSUS subheading text match.

product_description: A wooden dining chair with four legs, a back, and no upholstery, for household use
source: HTSUS heading 9401 covers seats and parts thereof; 9401.61 is upholstered seats with wooden frames and 9401.69 is the other (non-upholstered) seats with wooden frames -- a plain wooden dining chair with no upholstery belongs under 9401.69, so the prefix is checked at the full 6-digit subheading, not just the 9401.6 group.

product_description: Men's knit cotton t-shirts, short-sleeved, crew neck, 100% cotton jersey knit fabric
source: Schedule B mirrors the HS-6 of HTS for this heading (both derive from the same international Harmonized System nomenclature at the 6-digit level) -- same CBP/HTSUS basis as the import case above.

product_description: A laptop computer, a portable automatic data processing machine weighing under 10 kg with a keyboard and display in the same housing
source: Schedule B 8471.30 mirrors HTS 8471.30 at the HS-6 level -- Census Schedule B nomenclature for portable ADP machines.

product_description: Raw unroasted coffee beans, not decaffeinated, in bulk bags
source: Schedule B/HTS heading 0901 covers coffee; subheading 0901.11 is 'Coffee, not roasted, not decaffeinated' -- direct HS-6 nomenclature match, a very well-known/stable classification.

product_description: Soybeans, whether or not broken, for crushing or animal feed
source: HS heading 1201 covers soybeans; this is one of the most heavily-traded, best-documented U.S. export commodities and its classification is not contested -- direct HS-6 match.

product_description: A stainless steel vacuum-insulated double-wall drinking bottle with a screw-on lid, household use
source: Schedule B 9617.00 mirrors HTS 9617.00 at the HS-6 level, same basis as the import case above.

product_description: Women’s blue denim jeans, 100% cotton, five-pocket, woven, for adult women
source: Heading 6204 covers women’s or girls’ woven trousers; subheading 6204.62 is of cotton (HTSUS). Regression case: before the ancestor-text index (migration 0023) retrieval returned only the men’s 6203 branch.
